page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words; running head at top, page number at top right; no margin notes.

main_text.p: טמש Ch.Mergere,demergere, immergere, intingere. Ithpah. אִתְטְמַשׁ Intingi, immergi.
טנר טְנַרוּ Ch.Ambo,Duo cõjunctim,Bini,Jobi 17.6. טְנָרס Ch.Tentorium. Plur. טְנָרִין, Levit.25.31.in Jon.

טנן Ch. & Syr. Invidere, Invidiâ moveri, commoveri, æmulari, zelotypum esse,zelotypiâ affici. Aphel אַטְנֵן & אַטְנֵן Ad æmulationem, zelotypiam provocare. Pahel טְנֵן Idem. Item Confpurcare, inquinare, Jobi 3.5.
טננא, טנָנָא Ch. & Syr. Invidia, zelus, zelotypia, æmulatio.
ܙܢܢܐ Syr. Zelotes, zelotypus, æmulator. Plural.
טנס טַאנֵם Ch.Thanes, nomen urbis, quæ Hebraicè vocatur צָעַן. Ponitur etiam pro Hebraeo אוּן, in Targum Jonathanis,Gen.41.45.
טונם Ch. Piscis marini nomen, Thynnus: Item χοῦν, Juncus, Exo.2.3.in Jon. pro Hebraeo גֻּמָּא.
טנע טִינָע Ch.Petra, Jobi 29.6: pro טִינָר.
טנף Pahel Chald. Inquinare, coinquinare, foedare, contaminare, polluere. Ithpahel אִתְטְנַף Inquinari, pollui, contaminari.
ܙܢܦܐ Syr. Impurus, inquinatus. Plural. ܙܢܦܐ.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced approximately; several vowel points and the Syriac forms in the last lines are uncertain and may differ from the printed type.
